title: Fall Roasted Vegetables
description: Butternut squash, sweet potato, Brussels sprouts and red onion roast on one sheet pan with garlic, rosemary, thyme and sage until the edges caramelize. A colorful autumn side that pairs with almost any roast.
swaps: Skip the optional parmesan and toasted pecans garnishes; finish with lemon juice, dried cranberries or parsley instead.
watch: If using the optional maple-mustard tahini dressing, check the mustard label.

title: Vegan Broccoli Salad
description: Crunchy raw broccoli, red onion, raisins and roasted sunflower seeds tossed in a tangy-sweet creamy dressing, with smoky coconut 'bacon' bits. A no-cook potluck classic built nut-free from the start.
swaps: Use an egg-free vegan mayo that is not cashew- or almond-based.
watch: Contains coconut (coconut bacon); some people with tree-nut allergies avoid coconut. Check vegan mayo label for nuts.

title: Easy Gluten-Free Homemade Rice-A-Roni Copycat
description: A one-pot rice pilaf where broken gluten-free spaghetti toasts in olive oil with onion and garlic before simmering with rice in savory broth. Nostalgic boxed-mix flavor without the wheat.
watch: Use certified gluten-free spaghetti (not regular). Check vegetable broth label for wheat, barley/malt or dairy.

title: Purple Sweet Potato Tater Tots
description: Grated purple sweet potato bound with arrowroot and seasoned with garlic and onion, shaped into tots and baked until crisp outside. Vivid, fun and naturally egg-free.

title: Easy Roast Potatoes
description: Halved baby potatoes roast in plenty of olive oil with smashed whole garlic cloves and thyme or rosemary sprigs until deeply golden and crunchy. Hands-off and endlessly useful.

title: Crispy Smashed Potatoes (Baked or Air-Fried)
description: Small potatoes are boiled, pressed flat, brushed with oil and seasoned, then baked or air-fried until the ragged edges shatter. Crispy outside, fluffy inside, with parsley on top.
swaps: Skip the optional butter and vegan parmesan mentioned in the post; oil only.

title: Vegan Mashed Potatoes
description: Fluffy mashed potatoes made creamy with plant milk and starchy cooking water, seasoned with nutmeg and finished with a drizzle of good olive oil and chives.
swaps: Use a nut-free plant milk (oat, soy or the light coconut milk the author suggests) and olive oil rather than vegan butter.
watch: If using coconut milk, note it is coconut. If you choose vegan butter, pick a nut-free brand.

title: Moist Vegan Cornbread
description: Tender, golden gluten-free cornbread where pumpkin puree and soured plant milk stand in for eggs and buttermilk. Lightly sweet and great with chili or a holiday spread.
swaps: Use a gluten-free flour blend that is nut-free (the author uses white rice flour plus cornstarch). Use oat, soy or canned coconut milk, NOT the cashew/almond milk the notes suggest.
watch: Use certified gluten-free cornmeal. Check GF flour blend for almond flour. Coconut milk is coconut.

title: Vegan Polenta with Mushrooms and Beans
description: Golden polenta made cheesy with nutritional yeast and a touch of turmeric, topped with balsamic mushrooms, tomatoes, white beans and spinach. Hearty enough to double as a light main.
swaps: Use a nut-free non-dairy milk (oat, soy or rice).
watch: Use corn grits/cornmeal labeled gluten-free.

title: Roasted Green Beans
description: Fresh green beans roasted hot with olive oil, seasoned salt and garlic powder until blistered and tender-crisp. A five-minute-prep weeknight green.
swaps: Skip the optional parmesan suggested in the notes.
watch: Check seasoned salt label (some blends contain wheat or dairy), or use kosher salt.

title: Easy Roasted Sweet Potatoes (Two Ways)
description: Choose sweet cinnamon-coconut-sugar medallions or smoky chili-cumin chunks; both roast until caramelized at the edges and soft in the middle.
swaps: For the chili-cumin version use avocado oil, not ghee.
watch: Cinnamon version uses coconut oil and coconut sugar (coconut).

title: Kale Salad with Carrot Ginger Dressing
description: Massaged curly kale piled with grated beet and carrot, avocado, radish, crispy roasted chickpeas and toasted pepitas, all drenched in a bright carrot-ginger dressing.
watch: Make the roasted chickpeas per the linked recipe; skip the optional cheese variation.

title: Citrus Salad with Fennel & Avocado
description: Juicy grapefruit and orange segments with roasted and shaved fennel, bitter radicchio, creamy avocado and mint under a lemony dressing. A jewel-toned winter salad.
swaps: Omit the pine nuts (tree nut) and the pecorino; add toasted pepitas, capers or Kalamata olives instead.
watch: Check Dijon mustard label.

title: Vegan Kale Quinoa Salad with Lemon Dressing
description: Fluffy quinoa and finely chopped kale with carrot, red onion, dried cranberries and pumpkin seeds, tossed in a zesty lemon-garlic-Dijon vinaigrette. Holds up well for lunches.
swaps: Use the pumpkin seeds, not the walnut option.
watch: Check Dijon mustard label.

title: Allergy-Friendly Cinnamon Chocolate Popcorn
description: Popcorn coated in a glossy cinnamon-candy caramel made from melted Hot Tamales and marshmallows, then drizzled with dairy-free chocolate. A festive movie-night treat.
swaps: Use a nut-free vegan butter (avoid cashew/almond-based brands).
watch: Check labels on Hot Tamales, marshmallows and dairy-free chocolate (e.g. Enjoy Life) for allergen statements.

title: Nut Free Trail Mix
description: Sunflower and pumpkin seeds stand in for nuts, tossed with raisins and mini dairy-free chocolate chips. Four ingredients and lunchbox-ready.
watch: Buy seeds processed in a nut-free facility; use top-allergen-free chocolate chips (Enjoy Life).

title: Ranch Flavoured Roasted Chickpeas
description: Chickpeas roasted until crunchy and dusted with a homemade dairy-free ranch blend of dill, chives, parsley, garlic and nutritional yeast. Bake longer for maximum crunch.

title: Thin and Crispy Gluten-Free Seed Crackers
description: Flour-free crackers made from pumpkin, sunflower, sesame, chia, flax and hemp seeds, rolled thin and baked shatteringly crisp. Perfect with dips or on a snack board.
watch: Buy seeds processed in a nut-free facility.

title: Cheesy Kale Chips
description: Curly kale baked low and slow with olive oil, nutritional yeast and smoked paprika until crisp and 'cheesy'. A crunchy, savory chip with no nuts at all.

title: Roasted Pumpkin Seeds
description: Seeds saved from a carving pumpkin, tossed with olive oil, garlic and paprika and roasted until toasty. A seasonal, nut-free crunch for snacking or salads.
swaps: Use olive oil (not the clarified butter mentioned as a substitution).

title: No-Bake PB&J Energy Bites (Nut-Free)
description: Oats, SunButter and honey rolled with chopped dried strawberries for a PB&J-flavored bite without the peanuts. Four ingredients, no oven.
swaps: Use certified gluten-free oats.
watch: Check SunButter and dried strawberry labels.

title: No Bake Sunbutter Granola Bars
description: Chewy no-bake bars made from oats, sunflower seed butter, maple syrup and vanilla, studded with vegan chocolate. A fast, nut-free lunchbox staple.
swaps: Use certified gluten-free oats; use a nut-free milk or coconut oil.
watch: Use top-allergen-free vegan chocolate (check for milk/nut warnings).

title: Toasted Quinoa, Fig & Dark Chocolate Nut Free Granola Bars
description: Toasted oats and quinoa with sunflower and pumpkin seeds, chopped figs and flax, bound with sunflower butter and honey, then drizzled with dark chocolate.
swaps: Use certified gluten-free oats; use dairy-free dark chocolate chips.
watch: Coconut oil in the drizzle (coconut).

title: Strawberry Fruit Leathers
description: Strawberries, lemon and a little sugar pureed and slowly dried into chewy homemade roll-ups. Just three ingredients and no additives.

title: Baked Cinnamon Apple Chips
description: Paper-thin apple slices dusted with cinnamon and baked low until crisp. A naturally sweet chip with nothing but fruit.

title: Easy Hummus
description: Whipping the tahini and lemon first gives this hummus an ultra-smooth, fluffy texture. Finished with olive oil and paprika, sumac or za'atar.

title: Guacamole
description: Chunky, authentic-style guacamole made by first pounding onion, chili, cilantro and salt into a paste, then folding in avocado and lime.
watch: Serve with corn tortilla chips labeled gluten-free.

title: Easy Salsa
description: Blender salsa with fire-roasted tomatoes, garlic, jalapeño, cilantro and lime. Smoky, fresh and ready in minutes.
watch: Serve with gluten-free corn chips.

title: The Best Baba Ganoush (Moutabel)
description: Roasted eggplant and a whole head of roasted garlic blended with tahini, lemon, cumin and smoked paprika into a silky, smoky dip.

title: Healthy Vegan Queso
description: A cashew-free queso blended from potato, carrot and squash with nutritional yeast, mustard, cumin and chipotle, then studded with green chiles. Warm, smoky and dippable.
swaps: Use rice, oat or soy milk (not nut milk). Use gluten-free tamari (or coconut aminos).
watch: Tamari must be labeled gluten-free.

title: Garlic and Chive Sunflower Seed Cheese
description: Soaked sunflower seeds blended with lemon, olive oil, garlic and chives into a tangy spreadable cheese; bake it briefly for a firmer, warm appetizer.
watch: If adding the optional miso, choose one made without barley (rice or soy miso, gluten-free).

title: Vegan Bruschetta
description: Ripe tomatoes, fresh basil, garlic and a splash of balsamic piled onto olive-oil-brushed toast. Classic, bright and summery.
swaps: Use egg-free, dairy-free gluten-free bread or baguette in place of the ciabatta.
watch: Many GF breads contain egg or milk; check the label.

title: Vegan Deviled Eggs (With Potatoes!)
description: Halved baby potatoes play the role of egg whites, filled with a golden, tangy mash of white beans, vegan mayo, Dijon and turmeric, then dusted with paprika.
swaps: Use an egg-free vegan mayo that is not nut-based.
watch: Check vegan mayo and Dijon labels.

title: Vegan Stuffed Mushrooms
description: Cremini caps filled with an herby sautéed stem filling scented with fennel, sage and rosemary, bound with flax and baked until golden.
swaps: Omit almond flour and add extra breadcrumbs (author's nut-free option). Use certified gluten-free breadcrumbs. Use a nut-free vegan mozzarella or skip it. Use chickpea or rice miso (not barley miso).
watch: Many vegan cheeses are cashew/almond-based; check labels. Miso can contain barley.

title: Baked Vegan Spring Rolls
description: Rice-paper rolls stuffed with five-spice mushrooms, cabbage, carrot and vermicelli, then baked crisp and dipped in hoisin. All the crunch of takeout with no frying.
swaps: Use rice paper instead of wheat spring roll wrappers; use gluten-free tamari instead of soy sauce; use gluten-free hoisin.
watch: Hoisin often contains wheat and sometimes peanuts; check label carefully.

title: Baked Lentil Split Pea Falafel
description: Herby baked falafel made from soaked lentils and split peas with cilantro, parsley, cumin and sesame, crisp outside and tender within. Serve as bites with the lemony tahini sauce.
watch: Chickpea flour should be gluten-free certified.

title: Soy Garlic Ginger Chicken Wings
description: Oven-baked wings tossed in a sticky honey, garlic and fresh ginger glaze. Game-day favorite without the fryer.
swaps: Use gluten-free tamari (or coconut aminos) instead of soy sauce, as the author does.
watch: Tamari must be labeled gluten-free.

title: Asian Quinoa Meatballs
description: Egg-free pork meatballs bound with cooked quinoa and flavored with garlic, green onion, sesame oil and a kick of sriracha. Great on toothpicks for a party.
swaps: Use gluten-free tamari (or coconut aminos).
watch: Check pork sausage and chicken broth labels for wheat/dairy; check sriracha label.
